name: medical-appointment-agent
description: Medical Appointment Agent with LangGraph and MCP support

scripts.start-full: concurrently --raw -n LANGGRAPH,MCP,UI -c cyan,yellow,magenta "python api/langgraph_server.py" "python api/mcp_server.py" "streamlit run apps/streamlit_app.py --server.port 8504"
scripts.api-public: echo 'Run: npm run api (in Terminal 1) then: ngrok http 8502 (in Terminal 2)'
